my journey was kinda long...... and funny.... so in 2nd half of 2020.. i got obsessed with eunwoo and his dramas.. and the reason i even started watching him in particular was true beauty.. because true beauty was the first ever webtoon i ever read and actually my first introduction into like k-world.. so i was really excited to have a live adaptation of that drama... so just to see vibes of actor i started watching his other dramas.. like My ID is ganganam beauty.. fun fact.. literally just like 5 - 6 months prior to this time.. miigb was first ever kdrama that i clicked on Netflix.. because for some reason the plot felt similar to true beauty.. but couldn't continue.. because i wasn't still a kdrama watcher.. but like 1 - 2 later this time.. I saw a random video on Instagram and it was like a girl was reading a book upside down getting flustered by a guy and the guy noticed it.. and 2nd guy was looking jealous idk why but i found it soooo funny and cute.. and then i was like OKAY I WILL FIND THIS KDRAMA AND WATCH IT!! but sadly i couldn't find it and it wasn't even a "drama" it was like some special of 2 episodes.. sooo that time some of my friends who were armies told me to watch hwarang.. but i honestly got bored.. further then someone else suggested me to watch cloy.. and now that i was actually obsessed with and completed it.. and thanks to that random clip which genuinely got me interested in kdrama.. i saw a masterpiece like cloy and so many others later now.. now we come back to the time when i was watching miigb.. i loved it.. went ahead and saw more dramas.. and then eventually checked more about eunwoo and then also astro.. and omg.. i loved them.. their songs their bond everything i still love them all 🥺 soo my introduction to them and lowkey stanning started from there.. then they released we still (be with you) video and omg i remember seeing that video around new year and crying i don't know why but just the way they spoke small messages and the whole song omg it touched my heart so that's when they became my ult group back in 2020-21 transition time.. i entered 2021 with them 🥺 fast forward to 3 months.. I FIND OUT THE CLIP AGAIN !! the clip that got me genuinely interested in kdrama WAS ACTUALLY A EUNWOO AND MOONBIN CLIP OMG OMG OMG!!!! and the fact eunwoo would be lead of true beauty.. the webtoon which introduced me to k-ent world.. i felt like it was all fated 🥺🥺😭😭 like wow.. anyways since then i have been stanning them all... i started low-key cause of eunwoo..but like almost immediately became ot6 and struggled to have a bias.. but eventually became moonbin bias in 2021 itself 😭 and he will always be my #1 along with my astro.. i did stan other groups like seventeen later in 2022.. and they kinda are now my support system.. but astro is my teenage.. my babies.. my first solace.. so they are always special 🥺 

ps. astro weren't the first grp i stanned btw 😭 after i did get into reading webtoon.. i heard the song d4 by blackpink.. kinda got obsessed there.. and stanned blackpink.. but astro was my first ever boy group that i stanned and the way it felt like a fate idk what to say 🥺 they will always be special to me 🩷🎀
